'''Hsoosh''' was an ancient hissing [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Language of Ceremony originating more than two thousand years before [[43 ABY]]. It was used mostly by the elite class to make formal vows. [[Natua Wan]] was able to speak this language.<ref name="Abyss" />
